prompt: Built-in imagegen: nine distinct crude prehistoric finds in a 3x3 warm ivory paper and matte gouache swatch. Cells: bone securing cord, bent branch holding tension, hide cushioning stone, wild grain in rock crack, shelter-edge anchor stone, digging antler, bark shielding ember, cord-cinched hide pouch, hollow stone with tapping pebble.

entries.review: Top-left: rough split animal bone with a frayed cord end secured at the split, no drilled hole.
Top-middle: flexible leafy branch bowed by an uneven vine tie, no shaped weapon.
Top-right: untreated hide folded under a heavy rough stone to soften contact.
Middle-left: several wild grains lodged in an irregular natural rock crack.
Middle-middle: rough stone holding down the irregular edge of a simple hide shelter.
Middle-right: naturally forked broken antler tip with damp earth clinging to its point.
Bottom-left: curved bark shielding a small smoldering fiber ember from open air.
Bottom-middle: rough untanned hide pouch gathered at its mouth by a crude fiber cord.
Bottom-right: irregular natural stone hollow and a separate small tapping pebble.
